Elena — thanks for the clear summary. Overview of next steps from Redwood:

1) We can change the invoice payee name and billing address on your account effective Oct 1.
2) We require a signed payee authority (template attached) + a tax document for our records. For US entities that is a W-9; for EU entities we ask for VAT registration evidence.
3) We will produce a PDF invoice preview for your review before the Oct 1 invoice cycle.
4) We need final written confirmation that Aurora will accept invoice delivery via our standard API/email channel and that treasury contact information above is final.

I attached a short payee authority template that legal prefers to receive signed. If you can return a signed PDF and the W-9, we will kick off the mapping and provide the invoice preview by Sept 24.

Operational notes for the migration team: CCing Aditya (billing ops) and Laura (finance lead) to triage subscription mapping and verify there are no product tax overrides that need special handling.

Attachments included: payee_authority_template.docx

Markus Klein

Thanks — received the signed authority and W-9. That gives us what we need to start internal provisioning. Quick runbook and timeline: 

- Sept 16: Finance ops (Redwood) validates attachments and creates the new payee record in our billing system.
- Sept 20: Billing ops ties subscriptions SUB-8421 / SUB-8422 / SUB-9510 to the new payee entity in a staging tenant; we’ll generate an invoice preview.
- Sept 24: Invoice preview shared with Aurora treasury for sign-off (PDF).
- Oct 1: Live cutover — invoices issued to Aurora Therapeutics, Inc., using the new billing address and tax fields.

Notes on tax/VAT: because this is a US domestic re-mapping with an EIN provided there is no VAT change in our system. If you later add EU operations please flag for VAT handling.

Action items for Aurora:
- Confirm the ACH details included in your message are the final remit instructions.
- Confirm you accept the invoice delivery channel (we’ll send the official invoice to finance@aurorapt.com and post via the billing API).

We will also provide a temporary invoice number prefix mapping document so your AP team can reconcile the first live invoice.

Markus
[Attachment: invoice_preview_Aurora-0926.pdf (PDF, 24 KB)]
